dialogues.speaker: Fariha
dialogues.text: I'm Mr. Nizam's secretary. I'm responsible for taking minutes for him.

dialogues.speaker: Fariha
dialogues.text: If you see Mr. Nizam scowling or sighing in frustration, please don't take it personally. That's just how he is.

dialogues.speaker: Fariha
dialogues.text: Just make your request in advance and he'll make sure it gets taken care of.
